# MAVLink C headers

These are the upstream generated MAVLink 2 C headers for the `common` dialect,
with its `standard` and `minimal` dependencies and shared headers. Source:
[`mavlink/c_library_v2`](https://github.com/mavlink/c_library_v2), commit
`a2d0ecf011a4aaa7840480e43f4e38d8c9e79d29`. The files are included
locally so a clean checkout builds without downloading a dependency.

The generated headers are used under the MAVLink license in [COPYING](COPYING).
The generator and unrelated dialects are not included here.
